messages:
morgan: Heads up — onboarding sample app shows a raw 'API Error' (500) with zero context. New users get stuck on first run.
jas: Yep, saw that. It's coming from the python SDK wrapper surface — we don't expose typed exceptions. We should map common statuses: 401->AuthError, 403->PermissionError, 429->RateLimitError (+retry-after), 5xx->ServiceUnavailableError.
anil: Strong +1. Also include structured fields: `error.code`, `error.type`, and a `retry_hint` (cooldown seconds or backoff hint).
lina: Do we have parity planned for the TS/Go SDKs? TS currently re-throws raw http errors.
jas: Not yet fully parity. I have a WIP in python and will open a TS PR next. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/clients/pull/2345 (tests + mapping table).
sam: For onboarding UX I think the sample app should catch both typed and generic errors and show a friendly CTA: "Try again in Xs or contact support". I'll open a docs+sample PR to switch to the typed handling pattern.
morgan: Can we standardize the retry guidance string? e.g. `{ "retryable": true, "cooldown_seconds": 30, "reason": "rate_limit" }` so sample apps can surface consistent text.
anil: Also please ensure we don't leak internal traces or stack dumps in messages returned to customers. redact internal_log_id but surface a public `request_id` for support.
errbot: deploy-bot: staging deploy failed 1h ago — error payload includes `message: "API Error"` (no structured fields). tagging @jas @morgan
jas: Thanks — I'll prioritize the mapping change and add a middleware to enrich errors before they hit the sample app. @lina can you audit TS surface once I push?
lina: :thumbsup: Will do quick pass after your PR lands. Also recommend adding an integration smoke test asserting `instanceof RateLimitError` for the client libs.
sam: I'll add the smoke test to the sample app CI and include a tiny snippet in onboarding docs showing `try/except` example.

morgan: Minimal example we can land in docs:
```python
from redwood import Client, RateLimitError

client = Client()
try:
    client.generate(...)
except RateLimitError as e:
    print(f"Rate limited, retry after {e.retry_hint or 'a few'} seconds")
except Exception as e:
    print("Something went wrong — open a support ticket: support@redwood.ai")
```

jas: LGTM. I'll aim to have python PR merged today and open TS follow-up. Will post changelog and migration notes.
sam: Thanks — once PRs land I'll update the onboarding sample and docs to show the new ergonomic pattern.
extra_note: No title field per agents.md rules. Thread is focused on improving error ergonomics in onboarding/sample apps and achieving SDK parity for typed exceptions and status mapping.
